newsitem.title: USA: MedPartners completes purchase of Aetna unit.
newsitem.headline: MedPartners completes purchase of Aetna unit.

text.p: MedPartners Inc said on Friday it completed a transaction in which it acquired Aetna Professional Management Corp, the physician management arm of Aetna Inc's health business unit.
MedPartners also said it acquired most of the HealthWays Family Medical Centers and affiliated group practices located in seven metropolitan areas for undisclosed terms.
The acquisition included 47 HealthWays and affiliated medical centers employing 189 physicians, as well as six independent physician associations, MedPartners said.
HealthWays and the affiliated centers were located in markets where MedPartners already had a presence, including Atlanta, the Baltimore and northern Virginia area, Philadelphia and Dallas, it said.
HealthWays and the affiliated centers provided primary and specialty care to about 280,000 individuals, including 40,000 Aetna U.S. Healthcare members, MedPartners said.

Larry House, MedPartners chairman said: "This transaction represents an impressive addition to the quality healthcare services provided by MedPartners affiliated physicians in major markets both in the east and in the west."
